corpus_name: NimeshBuild bounded static rule accuracy corpus
metric_unit: One explicitly labeled rule-presence assertion per case, not confirmed vulnerabilities. Other rule findings are recorded but are not scored without labels.
provenance: Project-authored synthetic cases; not an independent industry benchmark or production prevalence sample. Expected labels were authored from API behavior, not inferred from scanner output.
scope: Synthetic, project-authored rule-presence fixtures. These are not production accuracy estimates or proof of security. Challenge cases are included in overall metrics even when the regression gate passes.
